body.label: Trigger
body.html: You would suffer forced movement or be knocked Prone.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Reduce the forced movement by 2 units or remain standing. Until your next turn, the first enemy that enters your space or reach treats it as difficult terrain.

surges.html: Until your next turn, the first enemy that enters the difficult terrain created by this Reaction becomes Chilled.
Increase the forced-movement reduction from this Reaction by 1 unit.
